summary.text: Barbara Carpenter is a Democratic member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 63, representing East Baton Rouge, according to the House member page.
The page lists 2015 as the year elected.

paragraphs.text: The House member page lists Barbara Carpenter's occupation as Dean of International Education and University Outreach, Southern University - Baton Rouge.

It lists Barbara Carpenter's education as B.S., Vocational Education and General Science, Southern University; M.Ed, Secondary Education and Administration, Southern University; PhD, Adult and Occupational Education and International Education, Kansas State University.

The House member page lists Barbara Carpenter's committee assignments as Appropriations; Education; House Executive Committee; Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget; House Select Committee on Women and Children.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Capital Region Legislative Delegation; Democratic Caucus; Louisiana Legislative Black Caucus; Louisiana Legislative Women's Caucus.
